explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/884: is Σ_{i<j} 1/(d_j - d_i) ≪ 1 + Σ_i 1/(d_{i+1} - d_i) over the divisors of n? Disproved (Tao conditionally; Larsen unconditionally). The two sums are computed via Nat.nth (· ∣ n), giving the ordered divisors, with rational differences. The statement negates the O-bound. Faithful.
